contents.name: Example 4.1.3, character table of C2 x C2
contents.reason: The character table of C2 x C2 is not part of this pair's designed interface, which mints exactly the additive-character definition, the one-dimensional dictionary and row orthogonality; this page's worked table is Z/5Z on the companion examples page. The earlier disposition already-published to ex-the-character-table-of-a-four was false: that item is the character table of A4, a different group. The general direct-product classification is treated later in the representation-theory track and is not citable at this order, so the C2 x C2 table is deliberately not built here.
